summary: Give the packaging unit a unique identifier (UPI), a clear name and its level. The DoC and TD use it to say exactly which packaging they cover.
为包装单元设定唯一标识（UPI）、清晰的名称及层级。DoC 与技术文档以此准确说明所涵盖的包装。
terms: UPI
UPI（唯一包装标识）
Platform identifier for one packaging type; appears as 'No.' and 'object of the declaration' in the DoC (Annex VIII points 1 and 4).
平台为一种包装类型设定的标识；在 DoC 中作为“编号”和“声明对象”（Annex VIII 第 1、4 点）。
Packaging level
包装层级
Sales, grouped, transport or e-commerce packaging (Art 3 definitions).
销售、组合、运输或电商包装（Art 3 定义）。
logic: One DoC per packaging type (Annex VII point 4; Commission FAQ). The UPI makes the type unambiguous.
每种包装类型一份 DoC（Annex VII 第 4 点；委员会 FAQ）。UPI 使类型明确无歧义。
The level decides which rules apply, e.g. Art 24 empty space only for grouped/transport/e-commerce.
层级决定适用规则，例如 Art 24 空隙率仅适用于组合/运输/电商包装。
info: Edit these on the Packaging & BOM tab — the item is filled from the register.
请在“包装与 BOM”页编辑——本项由登记表自动填充。
recommended: Use a stable code, e.g. brand-format-size-rev (ACME-POUCH-500G-R1)
使用稳定编码，如 品牌-形式-规格-版本（ACME-POUCH-500G-R1）
steps: Open Packaging & BOM, edit the unit, fill UPI, name and level, save.
打开“包装与 BOM”，编辑单元，填写 UPI、名称与层级，保存。
good: UPI LCC-CARD-A5-R2 ·“A5 色卡”· 销售包装。
bad: UPI equals the SKU of the product inside — breaks when the product changes.
UPI 等同于内装产品 SKU——产品变化时失效。

summary: Record the unit's total mass (g) and outer dimensions (mm). They are the baseline for minimisation (Art 10), the empty-space ratio (Art 24) and the BOM mass check.
记录单元总质量（g）和外形尺寸（mm）。它们是最小化（Art 10）、空隙率（Art 24）及 BOM 质量核对的基线。
terms: Empty-space ratio
空隙率
(total volume of the outer packaging − volume of sales packaging inside) ÷ total volume (Art 24(3)).
（外包装总体积 − 内装销售包装体积）÷ 总体积（Art 24(3)）。
logic: Annex IV Part B asks for the calculation of the minimum weight and volume, incl. batch variation.
Annex IV Part B 要求计算最低重量与体积，并考虑批次差异。
The platform compares this mass with the sum of BOM component masses (± 10 %).
平台将该质量与 BOM 组件质量之和比对（±10%）。
info: Mass in g (average of ≥ 5 samples recommended), L × W × H in mm.
质量（g，建议取 ≥ 5 个样品平均值），长 × 宽 × 高（mm）。
steps: Weigh 5 empty units, average them; measure outer dimensions; enter on the Packaging & BOM tab.
称量 5 个空单元取平均；测量外形尺寸；在“包装与 BOM”页填写。

summary: The platform builds this item from your BOM: one line per component with material, mass and supplier. Make sure nothing is missing — inks, adhesives, labels and closures are components too.
本项由平台根据 BOM 自动生成：每个组件一行，含材料、质量和供应商。请确保无遗漏——油墨、胶黏剂、标签和封口也是组件。
terms: Integrated vs separate component
集成组件与分离组件
Integrated: stays attached (label, glue, ink); separate: removed by the user (lid, sleeve). Art 6(9) treats them differently.
集成组件：保持附着（标签、胶、油墨）；分离组件：由用户取下（盖子、套标）。Art 6(9) 对二者区别对待。
logic: Annex VII 2(b) requires the materials of components; recyclability is assessed per unit including integrated components and separately for separate components (Art 6(9)).
Annex VII 2(b) 要求列明组件材料；可回收性按单元（含集成组件）评估，分离组件单独评估（Art 6(9)）。
info: Every component: type, material, mass (g), supplier / trace code, recycled content % for plastic.
每个组件：类型、材料、质量（g）、供应商/追溯码、塑料的再生含量 %。
minimum: Every component has material and mass
每个组件均有材料与质量
recommended: Link each component to the supplier library so certificates are checked automatically
将每个组件关联至供应商库，以便自动核对证书
steps: Open Packaging & BOM; add or import components (PPWR_BOM_V1.xlsx or Smart import).
打开“包装与 BOM”；添加或导入组件（PPWR_BOM_V1.xlsx 或智能导入）。
good: C001 board GC2 13.6 g · C002 water-based ink 0.3 g · C003 PVA glue 0.1 g.
C001 GC2 纸板 13.6 g · C002 水性油墨 0.3 g · C003 PVA 胶 0.1 g。

summary: Upload the full material composition of each component (supplier declaration), including additives, coatings and inks — the basis for the substance assessment.
上传每个组件的完整材料成分（供应商声明），包括添加剂、涂层和油墨——物质评估的基础。
terms: Substance of concern
关注物质
Substance defined in Art 3 (e.g. hazardous under CLP, SVHC, or hindering re-use/recycling).
Art 3 定义的物质（如 CLP 危害物质、SVHC 或妨碍重复使用/回收的物质）。
logic: Art 5(1) requires minimising substances of concern; Art 5(4) limits heavy metals — both need to know what is in the material.
Art 5(1) 要求尽量减少关注物质；Art 5(4) 限制重金属——两者都需了解材料成分。
The Commission's draft SoC list (consultation, July 2026) signals substances that may be targeted later.
委员会关注物质清单草案（2026 年 7 月征询）提示日后可能受限的物质。
info: Per component: substances / CAS numbers above the declared threshold, or a full-disclosure declaration.
每个组件：超过声明阈值的物质 / CAS 号，或全成分披露声明。
recommended: Ask suppliers to state SVHC (REACH Candidate List) content explicitly
要求供应商明确声明 SVHC（REACH 候选清单）含量
steps: Request a composition declaration per component from each supplier; upload as DCL.
向各供应商索取每个组件的成分声明；以 DCL 类型上传。
good: Board: virgin fibre 92 %, CaCO3 6 %, starch 2 %; no SVHC > 0.1 %. Signed 2026-05-10.
bad: Safety data sheet of a different product.
其他产品的安全数据表。

summary: Explain how you assessed that this unit is recyclable: its materials, main-component share, the collection and sorting stream it goes to, and whether all components are compatible with recycling.
说明如何评估该单元可回收：材料、主要组件占比、进入的收集分选流向，以及所有组件是否与回收相容。
terms: Design for recycling
按设计可回收
Packaging designed so it can be recycled into secondary raw material of sufficient quality (Art 6(2)(a)).
包装设计使其可回收为质量足够的再生原料（Art 6(2)(a)）。
Recyclability grade A/B/C
可回收等级 A/B/C
Performance grades defined by delegated acts (Annex II Table 3) — not yet available.
由授权法案界定的性能等级（Annex II 表 3）——尚未出台。
logic: Art 6(1) applies now; the design-for-recycling criteria and grades apply from 1 Jan 2030 (or 24 months after the delegated acts).
Art 6(1) 现已适用；按设计可回收准则与等级自 2030-01-01（或授权法案后 24 个月）起适用。
Until then, document the method you used; EN 13430 can guide but gives no presumption of conformity.
在此之前，记录所用方法；EN 13430 可作指引但不产生符合性推定。
The Commission FAQ expects the recyclability assessment result in the TD before placing on the market.
委员会 FAQ 期望在投放市场前将可回收性评估结果纳入技术文档。
info: Material identification; main component mass share; collection/sorting stream; compatibility of inks, adhesives, labels, closures; conclusion; expected grade (estimate).
材料识别；主要组件质量占比；收集/分选流向；油墨、胶黏剂、标签、封口的相容性；结论；预期等级（估计）。
minimum: 已在 C05-21 注明方法
recommended: Note the expected grade so 2030 gaps are visible now
注明预期等级，以便现在识别 2030 年差距
steps: List the materials and the main component's share of unit mass from the BOM.
根据 BOM 列出材料及主要组件占单元质量的比例。
Name the collection and sorting stream (e.g. paper & board).
注明收集与分选流向（如纸和纸板）。
For each integrated component, state why it does not hinder recycling (evidence: C05-20).
对每个集成组件，说明其为何不妨碍回收（证据：C05-20）。
Write the conclusion and the method used.
写下结论及所用方法。
good: Mono-material paperboard (main component 97 %), paper & board stream; water-based inks and PVA glue repulpable (supplier data C05-20); recyclable by design — EN 13430 used as guidance; expected grade A/B pending delegated act.
单一材质纸板（主要组件 97%），纸和纸板回收流；水性油墨与 PVA 胶可碎浆（供应商资料 C05-20）；按设计可回收——以 EN 13430 为指引；预期 A/B 级，待授权法案确认。
bad: 'Recyclable' with no method, stream or component analysis.
只写“可回收”，没有方法、流向或组件分析。

concl.ph: Material … main component … % · stream … · components compatible because … · method …
help: 材料 → 占比 → 流向 → 组件 → 结论。

summary: Name the method or standard you used for the recyclability assessment (Annex VII 2(d) — technical specifications applied or solutions adopted).
注明可回收性评估所用的方法或标准（Annex VII 2(d)——所采用的技术规范或解决方案）。
logic: Until the Art 6(4) delegated acts exist there is no PPWR harmonised method; say what you used and that it is guidance.
在 Art 6(4) 授权法案出台前没有 PPWR 协调方法；说明所用方法并注明其为指引。
info: Standard / guideline name and edition, plus any national or industry protocol.
标准 / 指南名称及版本，以及任何国家或行业规程。
recommended: State 'used as guidance — no presumption of conformity under the PPWR'
注明“作为指引——在 PPWR 下不产生符合性推定”
steps: Enter e.g. 'EN 13430:2004 (guidance) + recycler acceptance test'.
填写如“EN 13430:2004（指引）+ 回收商接受性测试”。
good: EN 13430:2004 used as guidance; repulpability test per paper-industry protocol (report PU-001-TST-004).
以 EN 13430:2004 为指引；按造纸行业规程进行碎浆测试（报告 PU-001-TST-004）。

summary: Only for packaging with a plastic part: record plastic mass, post-consumer recycled mass and the % — or why Art 7 does not apply.
仅适用于含塑料部分的包装：记录塑料质量、消费后再生料质量及百分比——或说明 Art 7 为何不适用。
terms: Post-consumer recycled content (PCR)
消费后再生料（PCR）
Plastic recovered from post-consumer waste meeting Art 7(3).
从消费后废物中回收且满足 Art 7(3) 的塑料。
logic: Targets apply from 1 Jan 2030 (or 3 years after the Art 7(8) implementing act), averaged per plant and year.
目标自 2030-01-01（或 Art 7(8) 实施法案生效后 3 年）起适用，按工厂和年度平均。
Exempt: plastic part < 5 % of the unit weight, and the cases in Art 7(4)-(5).
豁免：塑料部分 < 单元重量 5%，以及 Art 7(4)-(5) 所列情形。
info: Applicability; plastic part mass (g); PCR %; calculation basis; or exemption reason.
适用性；塑料部分质量（g）；PCR %；计算依据；或豁免理由。
minimum: 适用性与 BOM 一致
steps: Check the BOM for plastic components and their share of unit mass.
检查 BOM 中的塑料组件及其占单元质量的比例。
No plastic or < 5 % → select 'Not applicable' with the reason.
无塑料或 < 5% → 选择“不适用”并写明理由。
Otherwise enter the PCR %.
否则填写 PCR %。
good: Applicable: LDPE film 12.5 g, PCR 30 % (supplier mass-balance certificate).
适用：LDPE 膜 12.5 g，PCR 30%（供应商质量平衡证书）。
bad: 填写 PCR % 但未说明对应组件。

help: Percent PCR in the plastic part.
塑料部分的 PCR 百分比。
